content.text: Auto Marketplace QLD ('we', 'us') is committed to protecting your privacy and the personal information we collect and hold. This policy explains how we handle your information, why we collect it, and your rights.

items: Personal information: such as your name, email address and billing details when you interact with our services.
Non-personal information: such as usage data, device details, session logs, and cookies when you use our website.

title: How We Store and Protect Information

content.text: Your information may be stored electronically or in hard copy, either by us or our trusted service providers. We take reasonable steps to protect it from unauthorised access, but recommend you also take care in safeguarding your own information.
We may use your information to:

items: respond to your enquiries and process payments;
improve our products, services and website;
send you marketing about products, services or offers (you can opt out anytime).

content.text: We will only use your personal information for the purpose it was collected, unless you consent to another use or the law requires us to do so.
We may share your information with:

items: third-party providers who help us deliver our services;
anyone you authorise us to share with;
government or regulatory bodies if required by law.

content.text: We do not sell or trade email addresses or personal details.

Our website uses cookies to improve your experience, personalise content, and analyse traffic. Third-party cookies may also be used for advertising and analytics. You can manage cookies in your browser, but disabling them may affect functionality.

Our site may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those sites, so we encourage you to review their policies before sharing personal information.
You may request access to, or correction of, the personal information we hold about you. Proof of identity may be required. In limited circumstances, access may be refused as permitted by law.
